# Docket build record (2026-10-02)

## Blockers (lead)

| Blocker | State | Effect on this build |
|---|---|---|
| B2, B3, B4, B7, B8 | FROZEN | built on: B4 decides every "in effect at cut" cell |
| B1, B9 | REPAIRED-PENDING-ADMISSION | no evidence-plane VALUE renders; the retained reports are not in hand (UNSILO_BUILD B1B9-REPORTS) |
| B10 | OPEN, quarantined | no seal; closures stay BUILDING |
| B5, B6 | RETAINED-INTEGRATION-VERIFIED | runtime evidence waits on the D-3 run |
| B11, B12 | RETAINED | B11 profile enforced by gates; B12 renders both claim axes |
| RECON-ECLASS | UNADMITTED | every evidence-class slot is ABSTENTION(CLASSIFIER_NOT_ADMITTED), trigger-enforced |
| UNSILO_BUILD D3-NETWORK | OPEN | boards-api.greenhouse.io, data.sec.gov and web.archive.org are denied by this environment's network policy |

## What runs

```
python3.11 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.lock
.venv/bin/python -m unsilo init      # migrations + gates (fails closed)
.venv/bin/python -m unsilo seed      # one-time genesis write; needs the packet in var/inbox/
.venv/bin/python -m unsilo verify    # gates + full ledger recomputation
.venv/bin/python -m unsilo replay    # rebuild from receipts, prove byte identity
.venv/bin/python -m unsilo serve     # http://127.0.0.1:8765/
.venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
```

The store is `var/unsilo.db` (gitignored). The Duolingo packet stays in `var/inbox/` and is cited by SHA-256 only.

## What was proven (executed 2026-10-02)

| Claim | Evidence |
|---|---|
| The seed writes the seven applications, 19 blockers, 8 action items, 9 notes, 8 claims, one audit run | `unsilo seed`: 303 receipts |
| Replay is a rebuild | `unsilo replay`: 303 receipts rebuilt in 54 ms; canonical dumps identical (`9cd9c4b8...` both sides for the live store) |
| No UPDATE, no DELETE anywhere in the store | every receipted and meta table has `_no_update` / `_no_delete` triggers; tests run UPDATE and DELETE against every non-empty table and both abort |
| A row cannot differ from its receipt | generated `<table>_receipt_image` triggers compare every column with `json_extract` on the after-image, require the exact key set, and abort otherwise; test inserts a row with a mismatched receipt and it aborts |
| The receipt hash is checked in the transaction | `meta_receipt_after_hash` calls `sha256_hex`, registered DETERMINISTIC + INNOCUOUS, under `trusted_schema=OFF` (DL-3) |
| Personal fields never enter the store | the packet parser keeps 11 of 129 lines by exact prefix; the test derives 11 forbidden strings (contact data, GPA value, account name, 7 outreach names) from the packet at run time and finds none in the canonical dump, and no skipped line appears verbatim |
| Honest states render | strip top and bottom; FROZEN and CLOSED off the strip (R21); UNKNOWN cells hatched with their B4 reason; audit kills UNRESOLVED (no artifact); evidence class ABSTENTION(CLASSIFIER_NOT_ADMITTED) |
| Knowledge-time travel works | a cut before the first receipt shows no applications (test) |
| Phone width | 390 px viewport: page scrollWidth 390, zero console errors (Playwright 1.56.0, Chromium 1194) |

## Decisions locked in this build, with mechanisms

| # | Decision | Mechanism |
|---|---|---|
| X-1 | Exact pins | `pyproject.toml`, `requirements.lock`; `db.connect` halts unless SQLite is 3.53.4; tzdata version recorded by every gate run |
| X-2 | One write path for every `stg_`, `core_` and `ev_` row, staging included | `ledger.Writer.insert`; generated triggers; staging is receipted so replay rebuilds it too |
| X-3 | Knowledge visibility is `receipt_id <= kr` | exact because `meta_receipt_monotone_time` forbids `recorded_at` going backwards |
| X-4 | Each page declares its cut and prints it | `?eff=` and `?k=` pin it; otherwise the clock is read once at the request boundary and the page says so (S8) |
| X-5 | One B4 decision procedure, two domains | same granularity and zone: order positions, identical to `v_interval_membership`; otherwise lifted to UTC seconds with tzdata 2026.4, a DAY cut being the set of seconds in that day (5.4); a FLOATING endpoint against a zoned cut is UNKNOWN (DL-1, S3). Registered in SQLite as `b4_truth` / `b4_reason` |
| X-6 | Every descriptive application field is a term row | corrections supersede; `value_kind = 'UNKNOWN'` states a gap; role, platform, req and location get explicit UNKNOWN rows when no source states them |
| X-7 | A blocker state carries its "as of" instant apart from its valid interval | FROZEN ends UNBOUNDED on the operator's "bedrock" statement; unrecorded starts stay UNKNOWN, so "B4 at cut: UNKNOWN" is shown, not hidden |
| X-8 | The evidence plane's gate is `meta_contract_status`, changed only by migration | the dashboard compares it with the Docket blocker records (all 13 AGREE today) |
| X-9 | Packet import is allowlist-only | `unsilo/docket/packet.py` `ALLOW`; batch records lines_total 129, lines_kept 11 |
| X-10 | Audit counts stored as reported; the five named kills are UNRESOLVED findings with `reported_status = KILLED` | the audit export is not in hand (R8); `v_audit_count_check` shows reported 9 vs 5 rows held |
| X-11 | Search is a disposable in-memory FTS5 index | rebuilt when the receipt head moves; the store file has no mutable table |
| X-12 | Pages never print U+2014 | Jinja `finalize` normalizes it; verbatim bytes stay in the store |
| X-13 | Web writes are local and token-checked | 127.0.0.1 only; urlencoded via the stdlib; per-process form token |
| X-14 | Duolingo's ATS is UNKNOWN in the Docket | the packet does not establish it; the operator's D-3 directive names Greenhouse board `duolingo`, and the D-3 run's evidence is what the Docket may cite |
| X-15 | Approximate and minute-stated times stay at DAY with the wording kept | R14; "Sep 30, 2026, 11:59 PM ET" renders verbatim beside the day |
| X-16 | "May 24-Aug 13" is `[2027-05-24, 2027-08-14)` | S3 successor-day rule; Aug 13, 2027 is a Friday, the program's last day |
| X-17 | Header reads UNSILO | the spec's "UNISILO" is read as a typo of the program name |
| X-18 | The research-surfaces table stays cut (DL-4) | its Tier 0-4 text is a `surfaces` note, so every spec fact still appears |
